primary_name: Ye Shi, argument against Sun Wu's historicity

names.name: Ye Shi, argument against Sun Wu's historicity

summary: Song-dynasty scholar's argument that Sun Wu's career was invented, citing the silence of the Zuo zhuan, the late rise of professional generals and the implausible palace-drill story.
bias_notes: A deliberately sceptical argument against the tradition.
reliability_notes: Known only as summarised and translated by Giles (SRC-000031); the work itself is not identified by title in the pilot doc.
